name: Paris
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Paris - Ile-de-France metropolitan area (France), from Roissy-Charles de Gaulle airport to Corbeil-Essonnes and from Versailles to Meaux. 1.53M+ OSM buildings (binary format), 5.76M+ commuters with demand built from real INSEE census data (Filosofi 2021, mobilites professionnelles 2021). Roissy-Charles de Gaulle airport with runways and taxiways. Full Seine river and waterway depth data. Protomaps basemap with water, parks and forests.
data_source: INSEE Filosofi 2021 (donnees carroyees, revenus et population) - INSEE Recensement de la population 2021, mobilites professionnelles - OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - Overture Maps Foundation (buildings)
